verdict.rationale: YYLO is a command-line orchestrator for coding agents. It shows one-shot non-interactive agent invocation (`yy pi --no-session '<prompt>'`) and JSON watch receipts carrying `state` and `exit_code`. It also has deliberately nonzero exit codes from `doctor workspace`, plus scriptable loops, YAML workflows and a run-until-completion script, all of which suit shell scripts and automation. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions or GitLab setup), a documented headless/non-interactive mode and credential handling for CI runners, and independent hands-on corroboration of running inside CI.
